hops --no-verify sql --json -q "SELECT substr(ts,1,10) AS day, count(*) AS n, round(avg(prediction),4) AS mean, round(stddev(prediction),4) AS sd FROM hive.mlpab177acc_featurestore.prediction_log_1 GROUP BY substr(ts,1,10) ORDER BY day" 2>&1 | tail -n +9 > .tmp_daily.json; wc -l .tmp_daily.json; cat .tmp_daily.json | grep -c day
